cells.action: Implement docs/history/knowledge-skill-pair/CONTEXT.md D1, D2, D3, D4 and D7 as refined by D8. Write two new skills, following the discipline of skills/bee-writing-skills/SKILL.md and the frontmatter shape of skills/bee-verifying/SKILL.md and skills/bee-verify-upkeep/SKILL.md (name, a `>-` description, `disable-model-invocation: true`, metadata with version '0.1', ecosystem bee and the bee-cli dependency). Each description ends with a `Not for` clause that names the other skill, and neither is for the in-flow write, which stays with bee-capturing. skills/bee-knowledge-setup/SKILL.md (D2): use ONCE per repo that has no docs/knowledge/ bundle. It reads the tree and never interviews the user for content; it points at .bee/expertise/knowledge.md for the craft and at `bee knowledge consolidate` for the printed writing rules, and restates neither. Steps: bundle absent, else route to bee-knowledge-upkeep; `bee knowledge bootstrap` when docs/specs/ holds specs, `bee knowledge new` otherwise, one area concept per real subsystem found in the tree; the orientation file at the one fixed path docs/knowledge/areas/project/overview.md (D8e), an area concept derived by reading the tree as .bee/expertise/knowledge.md ("The orientation file") describes; `bee knowledge seed-anchors`; prove with `bee knowledge check --strict` and `bee knowledge index --check`; offer the upkeep loop. skills/bee-knowledge-upkeep/SKILL.md (D3, D4, D7): the three outcomes clean, changed, blocked, as bee-verify-upkeep states them. Edit scope: docs/knowledge/ only; never product code; a concept that describes behavior the code no longer has is doc drift (fix the concept) or a product regression (report it, keep it out of this change). A `When a run is due` section with the D7 table, each signal beside the command that prints it (D8a): after a release; a concept reported wrong (`bee knowledge report`, the reported-wrong section); an orphan grade (`bee knowledge check --json`, the `freshness` object); a suspect concept loaded 5 or more times (the suspect list of that same object, joined with the `loaded` list of `bee knowledge report --json`); a concept loaded 5 or more times and never used (`bee knowledge report`). It says the numbers are starting defaults. It also says (D8b) that loaded-never-used is a weak signal while the report's silent cells outnumber its answered ones: such a concept may only be unreported, so it never makes a run due alone, and it is trimmed or retired only after the source reader confirms it is dead weight. A `When knowledge is read, written and revised` table with the D7 moments. The pass, numbered: 0 bundle present, else route to bee-knowledge-setup; 1 signals, from `bee knowledge report --json` (reported wrong, `loaded`, never used) and `bee knowledge check --json` (the freshness grades); 2 pick at most 5 concepts, ranked wrong count, then orphan, then suspect-and-loaded, then loaded-never-used, only from concepts that were loaded for work, and name the candidates left for the next run; 3 source wave, one read-only reader per picked concept through `bee dispatch prepare --runtime <rt> --kind gather`, each reads the concept, its bee.sources and its bee.anchors and returns held or drift with citations, and for a wrong report whether the signal is diagnostic or noise; 4 revise by the D4 rules, each stated once: grounded in the concept's own sources and anchors with the failing work only as the signal, a claim whose source cannot be read again is cut or marked as a guess, in place and headline first (title, description, the Read when line) and never an appended correction, a noisy signal revises nothing, a loaded-never-used concept is trimmed, merged into its owner or retired out loud with bee.superseded_by; `bee knowledge confirm` on a concept that held; 5 validate with `bee knowledge check --strict` and `bee knowledge index --check`; 6 ship or stop: for changed, one worktree and one cell of proven corrections landed with `bee worktree merge`; for clean or blocked, no worktree and an honest report of coverage. One sentence gives the reason for the limit of 5: a measured result that revision gain is flat from 5 to 20 concepts and falls beyond, from needless revision and drift (ReHarness, arXiv 2610.12668). skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md gains one short paragraph beside its cap-time re-confirm text (anchor: the paragraph that names `bee knowledge confirm --id <id>`): a loaded concept the cell proved wrong is fixed in place in the same commit, headline first; a wrong concept the cell did not fix is reported at cap with `--knowledge-wrong` (D8c). One sentence gives the reason for the limit of 5: a measured result that revision gain is flat from 5 to 20 concepts and falls beyond, from needless revision and drift (ReHarness, arXiv 2610.12668). skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md gains one short paragraph beside its cap-time re-confirm text (anchor: the paragraph that names `bee knowledge confirm --id <id>`): a loaded concept the cell proved wrong is fixed in place in the same commit, headline first; a wrong concept the cell did not fix is reported at cap with `--knowledge-wrong` (D8c).
